# SDA Home Choices

> Independent commercial advisory for the sale, acquisition and strategic review of Specialist Disability Accommodation (SDA) portfolios in Australia. Specialists in SDA divestment, acquisition and M&A for investors, providers and family offices, backed by proprietary transaction evidence and the SDA Market Report 2026.
